programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A spate of road accidents puts pressure on the emergency team. Dr Mark Putland tries to help a car crash patient, but the man appears to be hiding something suspicious in his underpants. Dr Miriam Yassa examines a cheerful 82-year-old biker with fractures, who suddenly takes a turn for the worse. Dr Emma West’s road trauma victim could have internal bleeding, but the cure could do more harm than good. Nurse Yasna Cardoza helps a patient who collapses after cutting his thumb on a coffee plunger.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Mark Putland assembles a crack team to save a man with a gunshot wound to the neck with a rare procedure to keep him breathing. Dr Jonathan Papson suspects a surf-coach has a shattered leg from a horror car crash, which could spell the end of the young man’s career. A worker is in agony after a fall on the job, and Dr Sarah Whitelaw and nurse Maddy Whyte fear he has serious spinal injuries. Dr Mya Cubitt heals a former boxer with neat stitches and helps him confront an unpleasant truth.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Nurse Yasna Cardoza’s patient slipped in the shower and his wounds are very deep – but the thought of an operation terrifies him. A gunshot victim has Dr Michael Dunne on high alert, as he examines the man’s bullet-riddled body for injuries. Dr Emma West treats a mum who could lose her fingers after a high-speed car crash. Dr Mya’s patient is in agony after falling from a shipping container. Dr Michelle Thornhill stitches up a young man who walked into a wall while checking his phone.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Split-second events throw lives into chaos. Dr Jonathan Papson’s trauma patient wasn’t wearing a seatbelt when her car rolled, but she’s more worried about what her dad will say. Dr Sarah Whitelaw’s motorcyclist collided with a car and went head-first through a window, and there are grave fears for his brother who was also on the bike. Dr Mya Cubitt’s scared patient has an unstoppable nosebleed, and security crash-tackles a violent man trying to smear blood onto staff.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Steve Pincus’s young patient could lose his hand after a shocking abattoir accident. A severe asthmatic struggles to breathe, but Dr Bjorn Makein suspects another trigger. Air ambulance delivers a quad-bike rider who crashed at high speed, landing on his head, and Dr Michael Dunne fears there could be spinal injuries. Nurse Lucy Stranger’s detective skills and charm are needed for a patient with chest pains. A wayward spider sends a high-speed road crash victim to Dr Jana Alexander.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A life hangs in the balance, as Dr Emma West rushes to meet a critically injured road trauma victim at the helipad. Every moment counts, as the unconscious patient has severe blood loss. Dr Lauren Cohen treats an American schoolboy who plunged 10 metres down a cliff. 20-year-veteran Dr Tom Razga treats the ‘walking wounded’ in triage, reassuring a highly anxious woman who has a small wound. Is Dr Michelle Thornhill’s patient constipated from pasta or is it more serious?

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A heavily pregnant young woman has collapsed at a train station platform, falling face-first and landing on her stomach. Dr Miriam Yassa is on high alert for the baby’s welfare, and the cause of the mum-to-be’s collapse. Dr Sarah Whitelaw treats a cyclist after a car hit him from behind. He can’t remember the accident or feel his feet. Support volunteer Jean is on hand for comfort and cups of tea and is a welcome distraction for stressed patients.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Australia’s paramedics fight to save lives in a race against time. Every second counts as new partners Mike and Eamon treat the teenage victims of a brutal assault. Intensive Care Paramedic Al races to the scene of a motorbike accident, where a tourist’s life hangs in the balance after colliding with a fallen tree. Flight Paramedic Ray treats an unlucky gardener with a shocking injury, but will the helicopter flight make his condition worse? And its all about the love for Taz and Amanda.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Amanda and Taz help a little patient who’s had a big fall. A shocking motorcycle accident in the high country leaves a family man in critical condition. Can surgery in the back of an ambulance keep him alive? Single responder Cam races to help a baby arriving in a hurry. Mike and Eamon respond to an emergency at the city’s busiest railway station, where a man who’s already survived six heart attacks is in a bad way.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Experienced paramedics Doddsy and Carina rush to help a horse trainer who’s in critical condition after being kicked in the face. Matt and the Air Ambulance crew attempt a difficult winch rescue to help a paraglider who has crashed in remote bushland. An out-of-control patient at a busy train station puts Taz and Amanda to the test. Newlywed Leonard has some exciting news to share, before he and Nat rush to help a newborn baby caught in a hit and run.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Taz and Amanda help a patient who has mysteriously collapsed at work in front of panicked customers. Flight Paramedic Ray rushes to help a young mother who has been badly injured in a high impact road accident, and is desperate to find her baby girl. It’s a race against time for Eamon and Mike as they rush to get a first-time mother to hospital before she gives birth. With a 40-kilometre journey ahead of them and contractions speeding up, will Eamon have to deliver the baby?

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Single responder Cullen races to the scene of a road accident, where a motorcyclist is unconscious and fighting for his life. Carina and Doddsy battle heavy traffic to save a child’s life, as his distraught mother performs CPR on the side of the road. Taz and Amanda treat a dog bite victim who becomes unpredictable. MICA paramedic Glenice hikes to reach an injured teenager, after a selfie expedition on a stretch of rugged coastline ends in disaster.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Amanda and Nicola rush to help to a terrified woman who is having a major heart attack. Medication will buy them time, but surgery is the only thing that can save her life. Leonard and Nat are called to a major traffic accident where a trapped driver is showing worrying signs of a devastating head injury. Doddsy and Carina treat a mountain bike rider with shocking facial injuries. Eamon and Mike play referee between an embarrassed allergy patient and his protective Mum.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Can Cam’s detective skills crack a critical case and help a young man with severe chest pain? A nervous drive to hospital for Leonard and Amanda, who’s laid back patient has major problems. Nicola and Risky are baffled by a woman’s bizarre symptoms. An out of control heart rate puts a Mum of 5 in the danger zone, and Ray helps a young woman who has been in a major car accident on a country road.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Amanda has a surprise in store to celebrate Taz’s ten years in the service, but the party is on hold as they rush to help a patient who’s had a fall. Cam answers a dangerous callout to save a man in personal crisis. Carina and Doddsy are on edge as they treat a woman who’s suffering a severe allergic reaction after being stung by a bee. Mike and Eamon’s concerns grow for a newlywed couple who've been thrown from their motorbike. Ray heads bush to help a dirtbike rider in trouble.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A bumpy ride as Amanda and Taz rush to a foster Mum in agony. Flight paramedic Matt races to help a teenage student in a critical condition after high jump practice ends in disaster. Can Nat and Leonard convince their laid back patient to come to hospital, after tests show he may be suffering a ‘silent’ heart attack? Eamon works his charms on a distressed cyclist who’s had a run in with a classic Melbourne hazard. Cullen attends an horrific car accident that’s left a young driver trapped.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A gripping emergency airlift for a woman who’s suffered a massive stroke. Risky and Nicola assess a great grandmother in serious pain, but what’s causing it? A fun day at a waterpark turns into a nightmare, as single-responder Al finds a patient with suspected spinal injuries. A high-impact collision has flight paramedic Matt heading to the coast, where a grandmother and her two granddaughters are in serious strife. Cam and Doddsy’s patients refuse to go to hospital without their beloved dog.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Royal Melbourne Emergency’s Dr Mya and Nurse Ebony brace themselves as paramedics bring in a volatile man who’s been on a two-day drug bender, putting himself and staff at risk. Dr Jonathan’s patient has a shocking fracture after falling four metres from a ladder. Dr Luke examines a man who has collapsed at home and suffered deep facial bruising, but what caused the fall? Dr Emma calls in reinforcements to save a mum whose life hangs in the balance after a high-speed crash on a country road.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A grandfather of nine has a broken leg and massive blood loss after a motorbike accident, but his vital signs aren’t showing Dr Jana Alexander and Dr Jonathan Papson the danger he’s in. A teen jockey has been crushed under a horse, fracturing her pelvis. However, the potentially career-ending injury is not Dr Mya Cubitt’s biggest worry. Dr Scott Taylor uses a clever hack for removing jewellery from swollen fingers, which isn’t something he learned in medical school.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At Royal Melbourne Emergency, a young abattoir worker is in agony after amputating her fingers. Dr Bjorn Makein and Nurse Sarah Thomas must stop the bleeding if there’s any chance of saving the woman’s hand. Dr Emma West’s patient has major head injuries after falling down stairs on her way to a wedding. Dr Michelle Thornhill treats a cyclist who’s come off his bike while not wearing a helmet. Dr Thomas Razga puts a young mum with an earring mishap on laughing gas, with hilarious results.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A crane operator crushed under falling steel at work is rushed to Royal Melbourne Emergency. Dr Jonathan Papson calls in reinforcements as the young worker’s vital signs worsen. Dr Emma West treats a pregnant woman who is semi-conscious and behaving erratically. Dr Michelle Thornhill reassures a man who has impaled a drill bit through his hand. But how will she get it out? Dr Scott Taylor recommends an electric shock to reset a father-of-two’s dangerously fast heartbeat.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Two teenage mountain bike riders who crashed in separate accidents are airlifted together to Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department. One of the teens has an insulin pump for diabetes; Dr Jonathan Papson hopes the life-saving device hasn’t broken in the crash. Dr Scott Taylor treats a paramedic who is now a patient after she was bitten by deadly snake while jogging. Drs Michael Dunne and Jana Alexander treat a seriously injured grandmother who was thrown off a horse, then trampled.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: In The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, a pregnant woman survives a car accident. Now, Dr Emma West must stop the terrified mum going into premature labour. Dr Sarah Whitelaw and the team battle to save a teen driver who’s rolled his car, is unresponsive, and has serious head injuries. Dr Scott Taylor fears a diabetic man might need an amputation. A trail bike rider has crashed face-first. Despite his injuries, he impresses Dr Michelle Thornhill with his resilience and wit.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: In Royal Melbourne Emergency, Drs Emma and Jonathan battle to save a father of two from bleeding to death after he’s thrown from a horse. Where’s he bleeding from? Dr Luke looks for the cause of a law student’s puzzling condition which has terrified her worried parents. Dr Michelle’s young patient is in agony from broken bones after a motorbike accident and doesn’t want his parents to know. Dr George has grave fears for a handy-man who’s fallen six metres onto concrete while helping a mate.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Heart stopping moments at The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department. Drs Michelle Thornhill and Martin Dutch have seconds to spare as a man struggles to breathe after multiple heart attacks. Dr Jonathan Papson fixes up an old friend suffering severe bee stings from his backyard hive. Everything changes in a moment as he races to attend a stabbing victim who has no pulse. Nurse Sarah searches for the baby’s heartbeat after a pregnant woman is injured in a car crash.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Every second counts at Royal Melbourne Emergency as injured people keep arriving. Dr Luke treats a tradie hit by a falling tree. Later, he rejects a patient’s offer to mend a broken leg with icy pole sticks! Dr Jonathan is concerned for a uni student who’s fallen six metres from the famous Hanging Rock. Dr Michelle treats a young motorcyclist with broken wrists who’s kept his bike a secret from his parents. Dr Martin helps a mum of two with a painful burn injury caused by boiling pasta.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: The pressure is on for Mike and Eamon, who arrive at the scene of a car accident only to find their patient has been stabbed and is rapidly losing blood. Nat and Leonard help a golfer who’s feeling sub-par. Matt airlifts a motorcyclist who has a collapsed lung, after a head on with a kangaroo. Glenice meets a hero dog that raises the alarm when his owner is knocked unconscious after being thrown from her horse. Amanda and Taz’s patient has intense chest pains, but is it a heart attack?

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Can flight paramedic Ray save the life of a high-country farmer with a dangerously blocked heart? Cam earns the trust of a toddler in trouble, after she suffers an allergic reaction. A volatile patient puts Taz and Amanda in the line of fire. Leonard and Nat treat a young Mum, terrified she’s been bitten by a funnel web spider. Eamon and Mike help a woman with chest pains and breathing issues, but what’s causing it?

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Cam responds to a call from frantic parents whose son has fallen through a glass window and is bleeding to death. A father son weekend becomes a Dad’s worst nightmare when his little boy is struggling to breathe. Leonard and Nicola help a grandmother in excruciating pain with a fractured hip. A young man suffering a rare condition has Doddsy on high alert. Mike and Eamon are confronted with a shocking Martial Arts injury, and Risky stops by with a special little visitor.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Glenice rushes to the rescue of a scared elderly man who's been trapped in his bathtub for days after a suspected fall. Cam is called out to help a tiny patient in big trouble. A grave situation for Taz and Amanda when they’re called to an accident in an unlikely setting. Nat and Leonard help a nurse who has crashed her car into a bush and is showing worrying signs of amnesia, and later, Nat wins herself an unexpected admirer.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Al and Doddsy are called to a rodeo to help a retired cowboy who’s returned to the ring with disastrous results. Glenice helps a young couple fighting to save their 6-year-old daughter who’s suffering from a rare and shocking disease. Amanda and Taz get a lesson on making a marriage last from a couple who have been married for more than 60 years, and an unpredictable patient with a head injury has Cullen on high alert.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Carina and Doddsy are on high alert as they rush to the scene of an horrific car crash, where a young man’s life is hanging in the balance. Amanda and Leonard help an 11-year-old girl with a heartbreaking story, after a suspected overdose leaves her lifeless on the floor. Cam steps in when a distraught woman is convinced she’s about to lose her husband. Eamon and Mike turn on the charm for their elderly patient, and is Leonard’s baby about to make an early entrance?

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Will Mike and Eamon need to break down doors to get to a possible stroke patient, who’s been collapsed inside his locked home for days? Cullen fights to save the life of a man who’s choking to death on a piece of ham. Taz and Amanda win over a volatile patient, who reveals a hidden talent as Carina and Doddsy are called to a case that hits close to home - a fellow paramedic who has been attacked on the job.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Cam’s young patient is pregnant with twins and showing signs of going into early labour. Will her twins arrive in the back of the ambulance? Mike and Eamon are also on baby watch as they help a young mother-to-be who has a scare at early stages of her pregnancy. A puzzling case for Nat and Leonard as they treat a patient with confusing symptoms, and a little boy with big dreams of becoming a paramedic pays a visit to two of his heroes, before Amanda celebrates a special milestone.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A heartbreaking story, as flight paramedic Ray joins a massive ocean rescue mission in treacherous conditions near Victoria’s Twelve Apostles, where a tourist has been swept out to sea. Single Responder Glenice is first at the scene of an horrific car crash where multiple patients need her attention. Taz and Amanda are called to a man suffering severe chest pains that has already survived three heart attacks. Will today be his forth?

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: An agitated burns victim makes for an anxious flight for Ray and the helicopter crew. A baby’s allergic reaction has Mike and Eamon working their charm on both bub and an anxious Mum. Amanda and Leonard team-up for a night shift, and rush to a 72-year-old with chest pains who thinks his time is up. A trip down memory lane for Doddsy and Glenice, before they rush to help a critically ill bus driver on the toughest journey of his life.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A man collapses in the hospital café. Luckily, it’s next to the ED, but Dr Jonathan fears the man’s luck is running out. Dr Laura and Dr Mark bend over backwards to perform what should be a routine procedure on a woman with a dislocated hip. Dr Emma is concerned that a young man with numbness down one side of his body may have a life-changing illness. A motorbike rider has horrific injuries after crashing through a wire fence. Dr Caitlin and Dr Michael fear the man might lose his foot.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A surfer has a heart attack out in the water. Dr Caitlin and Dr Martin are not sure they can save him. Dr Mya reassures a mum with agonising leg injuries after the woman was squashed between the motorbike she was on and a 4WD. A teen with a machete wound to his arm has Dr Michael on alert. Dr Mark and Dr Tessa treat self-described ‘idiot’ Paul, who has fallen ten metres from a tree, with a chainsaw. A footballer knows which bones he’s broken, but not how he did it.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Mya’s stabbing victim is hanging on to life with uncontrolled bleeding. Dr David’s patient has potential spinal injuries after crashing onto his head during a mountain bike race. Dr Emma and Dr Jonathan are worried about a great-grandmother with disastrous chest injuries from a car accident. A pregnant mother has Dr George and Dr Caitlin concerned, as the woman hasn’t felt her baby move at all. To help the doctors de-stress, Milo the dog proves a hit during bring your dog to work day.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A quad-bike accident has a race-track worker needing all of Dr Michelle’s skills, but his X-ray results confuse everyone. Dr Emma has a young man’s life in her hands as he bleeds profusely from the throat. Dr Catriona is worried a tradie might lose his sight after he comes in with terrible injuries from a workplace accident. Dr George and Dr Rosie need to electrocute the heart of a father of two. Dr Michelle challenges Dr Mya to an 8km fun run but Mya doesn’t fill Michelle with confidence.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Michelle and Dr Jonathan’s car crash patient, a nursing student, has such terrible injuries her life hangs in the balance. Dr George’s truck accident victim needs two tourniquets above the knee to stop severe blood loss, but if they don’t come off he’ll lose his leg. Dr Mya’s special brand of TLC helps a young woman in physical and emotional pain. Dr Michael is impressed with an 81-year-old man who walked in to hospital on his broken leg, but the man’s dizzy spells has Michael worried.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A car crash survivor needs litres of blood, but Dr Martin is struggling to find a vein that hasn’t collapsed. Dr Mya is juggling patients like balls in the air and hoping not to drop any. Dr Michael examines a motorbike rider with a damaged shoulder and smashed leg. He wants his mum, so ‘Mama Bear’ Gina steps in. Dr Andrew has a wee problem being understood, but the soon-to-be-Aussie has bigger issues with a young footballer showing signs of spinal and internal injuries after a hard tackle.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Nurse Ebony and Dr Jonathan are on high alert as their patient could turn on them without warning. Dr Mya and Dr David treat a young woman with a broken jaw who is at risk of choking after falling face-first off, her horse and is in a world of pain. Dr Luke and Dr Emma are grateful for a good early sign from a motorbike rider who collided with a car, but alarms soon ring out. Dr Tessa is astounded by a bush remedy used when a farm worker on a forklift fell in high winds, cracking his head.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Michelle and Dr Emma are on high alert for a mother-to-be who is paralysed and unresponsive from a suspected stroke. Every second counts as Dr Bjorn and Dr Martin’s critically injured patient clings to life after a one-tonne camper trailer rolled over him. A confused motorbike rider remembers nothing and feels no pain while Dr Michael searches for chest, spinal and brain injuries. Pregnant Dr Jana needs a covid-free room to drink water, then is back to re-set an artist’s broken wrists.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Sarah must numb a nursing student’s hand to clean her mangled fingers, but the woman won’t let her because she’s terrified of needles. Dr Ali suspects a former war correspondent has serious spinal injuries after the man rolled his car. First-time dads Dr Michael and Dr Luke swap nappy tales before it’s all hands on deck for a motorcycle rider with multiple fractures. Dr Emma and Nurse Emma fear a stoic 79-year-old grandmother might lose her leg after she was hit by a car crossing the street.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Trauma patients pour through the doors. Dr Jason searches a teen’s mud-encrusted body for breaks after the dirt-bike rider crashed in a race. Nurse Elle and Dr Steve suspect a cyclist with a badly broken leg is being far too brave, masking other injuries. Dr Mya and Dr Matt fear a young tradie could have a life-altering spinal injury after a fall at work. Dr Michelle puts lunch on hold as she and Dr Jonathan examine a 67-year-old motorbike rider for broken bones.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Australia’s ambulance crews are there for everyday people having their worst days. Natalie and Leonard comfort a schoolboy who’s fallen metres out of a tree on his head. MICA paramedic Cam fights to save a much-loved dad in cardiac arrest. Matt and the flight crew race to a fellow paramedic who’s been bitten by a deadly brown snake, but reaching the isolated patient is almost impossible. Mike and Eamon support a young woman with a debilitating yet all-too-common condition.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Everyday thousands of calls come through to Victoria’s ambulance service from desperate people. Nat and Leonard head to a hotel roof-top pool, where a romantic escape in the city ends in disaster for a young mum. Eamon and Mike race to a traumatised child attacked by a dog. Steve and Emily grow increasingly worried about an elderly nun who could be having a stroke. Flight paramedic Matt dashes to the high country as an off-duty firefighter’s life hangs in the balance after a motorbike crash.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Two million calls for help are made in Victoria every year. In rugged bushland, a dad with his two kids on board has crashed one hundred metres down a ravine. Getting the injured driver out is a nightmare and the teetering wreck could crush the rescuers. Mike and Eamon fear the worst as they rush to a teenager who has plummeted through a skylight, and can Emily and Steve save an elderly man who is on the brink of a cardiac arrest?

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A call is made every twelve seconds, from people across Victoria desperate for help. MICA Paramedic Cullen races to a young woman slipping into a potentially fatal diabetic coma. She’s so sick, any treatment Cullen gives could make things worse. A little girl’s terrifying seizure has Glenice on high alert. It’s the 8-year-old’s first attack and she’s unresponsive. Marlie and Tanie treat a skateboard rider who’s crashed at high speed without a helmet. Mike and Eamon reach a fun career milestone.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every twelve seconds across Victoria, a call for help is made to emergency services. Simon and Michaela perform a high-risk intervention on a brain tumour patient having seizures. Cullen races to a man trapped in a wrecked car after an horrific crash. Nat and Leonard help a ninety-one-year-old woman who fell hard while helping a neighbour. Alarm bells ring for Emily and Steve as a man with chest pain worsens dramatically. A young stabbing victim has Tanie and Marlie on high alert.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: On the frontline, paramedics work around the clock, fighting to save lives. Cullen faces every parent’s nightmare as a six-year-old child is hit by a car. Simon and Michaela battle to help a man whose pacemaker is misfiring, sending agonising shocks through his system. Tanie and Marlie fear for their safety as a patient suddenly turns violent. A food delivery rider comes close to disaster and an emergency airlift for a thrill-seeker motorcycle mum who’s catapulted off a cliff.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A 38-year-old man has suffered a massive attack while enjoying a day off with his wife in their spa. Cullen fears he could die before they get him to hospital. A teen footballer has collapsed after a bruising tackle and could have a serious head injury. Eamon and Mike’s charm offensive might not work with feisty 94-year-old Miffy. A man has collapsed in a supermarket and a language barrier makes Steve and Emily’s job even harder.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A 76-year-old motorbike rider suffers catastrophic injuries after a terrifying crash into trees. Veterans Al and Cam race to a lung cancer survivor gasping for air. Emily and Steve help an entertaining patient with mystery arm pain. Mike joins the ‘fun’ ambulance to help seriously ill children escape from their daily challenges. Glenice and Doddsy are called to a bizarre accident, and a heavily bleeding cyclist is enrolled in the Marlie school of safety.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Paramedics work around the clock fighting to save lives. A do-it-yourself loving handyman gets himself into trouble when he tumbles off a three-metre ladder. With no memory, the brave patient may have a brain bleed. Steve and Emily are ready for anything as an office worker is hot and dizzy, and down to his undies. Babysitting duties turn into a nightmare for a terrified grandmother. Eamon is unimpressed with Mike’s fashion sense, and a former grave digger laughs in the face of death.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Exclusive cameras capture the extraordinary work of emergency service heroes. Steve races to remote bushland where a huge tree has fallen and crushed a man’s leg. Cullen takes drastic action to save a patient whose body is shutting down. Cam and Al bend the rules to lift the spirits of a nine-year-old boy after a frightening asthma attack. Homesick Emily ‘adopts’ a Nanna for the day, when she and Steve help a much-loved grandmother and a terrified daughter watches her Mum fight for life.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: MICA paramedic Steve is forced to deploy a high-risk procedure to save a man whose heart is beating out of control. With his distressed family watching on, there are no guarantees the drastic treatment will work. Flight paramedic Ray fears the worst when a young woman crashes through her car’s rear window and smashes onto the road. It’s party time ahead of Leonard’s last shift with his great friend Nat but they will be confronted with one last challenge before an emotional goodbye.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Paramedics work around the clock, fighting to save lives. A terrifying home invasion shocks Mike and Eamon. Despite his own terrible injuries, the victim is desperately worried about his elderly mother. Taz and Amanda take care of a seriously ill little girl whose every day of survival is a miracle. Flight paramedic Ray struggles to understand a bizarre chain of events that began with a stranger knocking at the door in the middle of the night and ended in a house fire.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At the Royal Melbourne Hospital, trauma patients arrive around the clock for urgent care. Doctors Scott Taylor and Jonathan Papson fear for a pregnant woman injured in a high-speed traffic accident. Doctors Andrew Wallace and Jana Alexander urgently treat a jockey who was crushed under a horse. Doctor Jason Gabriel-Anyassor’s patient is in agony after crashing into a truck. Dr Martin Dutch and Nurse Sarah Thomas resort to translator apps to communicate with a scared young tourist hit by a car.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: It’s Manic Monday at the Royal Melbourne Hospital as trauma patients pour in. Dr George Plunkett and Nurse Sarah Thomas worry a motorbike rider could lose his leg. Doctor Glenn Harrison fears a tradie, crushed under 300 kilos of cement, has brain injuries. Drs Emma West and Mya Cubitt celebrate Dr Jana Alexander’s return from maternity leave with cake, then Dr Mya and Dr Jana diagnose a ‘healthy’ man with a ticking time bomb. Dr Emma investigates a pregnant woman’s chest and leg pains.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Lives hang in the balance at the Royal Melbourne Hospital. Dr Mark Putland and the Trauma team have minutes to save a truck driver’s severed leg. Drs Andrew Trezise and Emma West search for neck injuries on a cyclist who’s collided with a van. Then Nurse Eliza Burke notices a red flag. Drs Michael Conboy and Steve Pincus struggle to relocate a student’s jaw after he yawned. Dr Andrew Wallace and Nurse Chelsea Jones fear a champion horse rider might be paralysed after a hard fall.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: For 175 years, the Royal Melbourne Hospital has rescued people having their worst day. Doctor Scott Taylor fears a tradie has life-altering neck damage after a ladder fall. Nurse Susan Hartman keeps the man completely still, but soon his breathing fails. Doctor Jonathan Papson shares nicknames he’s earned at work, but it’s J-Paps medical skills that a power-boat racer needs after a spectacular high-speed crash. Nurse Practitioner Paul Casey needs help to reset a dislocated shoulder.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: It’s training day at the Royal Melbourne Hospital as Doctors Emma West and Jonathan Papson run new doctors through their paces with make-believe trauma patients. Playtime is soon over as Drs Jonathan and Emmanuel Karpathakis examine a cyclist with glass stuck in his neck. Any movement could be catastrophic. Dr Michelle Thornhill and Dr Martin Dutch struggle to get oxygen into a young mother having seizures. Dr Mya Cubitt uses her phone light to see where her young patient is bleeding from.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency department creates a puzzle for Dr Jonathan Papson: a teenage rugby player who received a hard tackle seems uninjured, so why is he struggling to breathe? Dr Terry Kane, who came to Australia on a whim, faces the worst trauma he’s dealt with. A motorcyclist has a broken pelvis and could bleed to death. Nurse Chelsea Jones also fears his forgetfulness might not be from painkillers but a brain bleed. Dr Steve Pinkus has shocking news for a heart patient.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At the Royal Melbourne Hospital’s emergency department, Doctors Jonathan Papson and Emma West’s friendly chat about peaches is quickly dropped as they treat a mechanic who could lose his crushed arm. Drs Michael Dunn and Mark Putland rally the team to save a truck driver who blacked out and smashed his semi-trailer into a tree. Dr Luke De La Rue’s decision not to ride his bike in the city is reinforced when treating a cyclist with a horrifically mangled ankle after being hit by a car.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At The Royal Melbourne Hospital, Dr Andrew Trezise worries a young dirt bike rider has life-altering injuries after a crash. The rider rolled a truck only the week before. The phone doesn’t stop ringing for Nurse Gunnar Petersen as patients pour in. Dr Jonathan Papson examines a showjumper in agony with multiple breaks after being thrown off a horse. Dr Michael Dunne and Nurse Ebony-Lee Butterworth look for hidden injuries in a stoic tradie who has fallen 3 metres off a roof.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At The Royal Melbourne Hospital, Doctor Jonathan Papson arrives fresh from a family emergency after his daughter’s car broke down with his staff card in it. Moments later, he discovers devastating news for an injured ute driver. Dr Tsung Chung cuts short his favourite meal - peanut butter and jam sandwiches - to help a woman in agony after a high-speed crash. Drs Andrew Wallace and Emma West fear a chef, who fell down an escalator, has brain injuries. Otto wins hearts and cuddles in the office.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Trauma patients arrive day and night to The Royal Melbourne Hospital. The moment Dr Jonathan Papson hears ‘motorbike’, he prepares for multiple injuries and a world of pain for his next patient. Later, he’s impressed with a mechanic’s pain tolerance after he was crushed under a ute when the jack gave way. Dr Andrew Wallace shows off his ‘fugly’ shoes and colourful socks before seeing his next patient who has a punctured lung and broken pelvis from a bicycle crash.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every eleven seconds a cry for help comes through to emergency services. Flight paramedic Steve heads to the country after a tractor topples over and crushes a farmer. Taz and new teammate Erika hope for the best and prepare for the worst as a much-loved grandma collapses at home. A woman having multiple seizures has Michaela and Simon on high alert. The mother of two’s life is in their hands as she can’t breathe for herself. Steve and Jade’s patient has severe pain, but what’s causing it?

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Alarm bells ring for Michaela, as a super-fit dad suddenly has slurred speech. Father-daughter team Brett and Teagan finally work together. They’re shocked by the deep gash on a woman’s leg after tumbling downstairs. Eamon and Mike are teaming up again, helping an elderly asthmatic man who can’t stop coughing. Veterans Doddsy and Andrew’s day is upended as they race to a motorcyclist crash victim with extensive injuries. A six-month-old baby gives Leonard and Cullen a huge scare.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Cam is confronted with carnage after a motorcyclist crashes into parked cars in a suburban street. The treatment Cam needs to perform could go horribly wrong, but without it, the patient will stop breathing. New partners Jodie and Nathan rush to an overheated triathlete who collapses over the finish line. Steve and the flight crew hold a rural GP’s life in their hands. Tanie and Marlie suspect a stoic 96-year-old is downplaying her symptoms as they look for signs of a ‘silent heart attack’.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Nicola and Risky have a quick catch up before it’s straight back to work, treating a disoriented driver who’s had a seizure and crashed her car. Mike and Eamon get all the red flags while treating a mother who’s having a stroke. Simon and Michaela work in cramped conditions, extracting an unconscious young man who’s collapsed at work and is unresponsive. Jodie and Nathan need police help to stay safe while tending an upset patient who’s putting himself and others in danger.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: In Victoria, a cry for help comes to emergency services every eleven seconds. Newly-minted MICA paramedic Leonard needs all his skills to help a karate student make it back from the brink of a cardiac arrest. Taz and Erika’s fragile patient starts to come good, then deteriorates fast in the ambulance. Flight paramedic Steve and the team respond to a horrific crash, where a single mum has gone off a bridge and landed into a river. Cam races to a young man with mysterious abdominal pain.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Simon and Michaela mentor a new paramedic in high-demand hands-on revival skills after a young man takes a heroin overdose. Mike and Eamon worry a teen could have life-changing head injuries after a fall and seizure at school. Nicola and Risky check an older driver for spinal fractures after a crash leaves him in agony, and he feels every bump on the way to hospital. Steve and Jade deliver essential care for an incredible woman whose deteriorating health is on a knife edge.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: An elite team is ready to save people having their worst day. Alarm bells ring for Cam and Doddsy after a healthy man collapses having multiple seizures. Jade is impressed with Steve’s skills as they support a scared patient who’s struggling to breathe with suspected Covid. Leonard and Cullen attempt a trick-move to stop a woman’s heart from racing. Tanie and Marlie suspect a stressed-out fraud victim could be having a heart attack.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Flight Paramedic Steve worries a teen motorbike rider could lose his leg, after a high-speed crash. MICA Matt faces a grim scenario, as a dearly loved great grandfather’s lung collapses. Taz and Erica are on high alert, when a drug-affected woman wanders onto the street. Father and daughter team Brett and Teagan have a gut-wrenching situation as a mother can’t wake her seven-year-old child. Mike and Eamon rush to a man who collapses in a pizza restaurant before his meal arrives.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Steve and Jade carry a top range of painkillers, but their motorbike crash victim won’t take any. Traffic slows Simon and Michaela as they race to a heart attack survivor drifting in and out of consciousness. Single-responder Jodie’s chest-pain patient has an alarming medical history. Marlie and Tanie’s elderly patient is in agony from a fall and can’t explain what’s happened. Father-Daughter team Teagan and Brett are called to a potential heart attack, but their patient is only in his teens.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: MICA paramedics Nathan and Jodie patch up a dirtbike rider who’s fallen five metres and landed on his bum. A suburban shooting has Cam and Al battling to save a young man’s life. He’s in critical condition with an open chest wound. Risky and Nicola are super-impressed with a spritely but unsteady 92-year-old. A road accident has given a young driver some small cuts, and Mike and Eamon then check for deeper injuries. An elderly woman’s dizzy symptoms puzzle single-responder Andrew.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: The Royal Melbourne Emergency Department is non-stop 24/7. Dr Mark Putland examines what’s left of a limestone quarry worker’s arm after it was mangled in a machine. Dr Assiya Halid checks a man for broken and dislocated bones after he collided with a car on his way to a date. Dr Jonathan Papson works carefully to remove a screw from a man’s thumb after a home DIY mishap. Dr Luke de la Rue fears for an unborn baby after a 30-week pregnant mother was hit by a bus.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department is ready to help people on their worst days. Dr Emma West fears a motor-cross rider has life-changing injuries after coming off her bike. Time is critical as Dr Scott Taylor’s unresponsive patient deteriorates with a suspected brain bleed. Dr Tristan Harding must straighten a young farmer’s severely dislocated ankle before the blood supply cuts off. Dr Mya Cubitt treats a cheerful 103-year-old legend’s leg for a nasty infection.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At the Royal Melbourne Hospital, Dr Michael Dunne and Dr Jonathan Papson urgently need answers for one of the sickest patients they’ve seen. The 47-year-old man can’t breathe with suspected pneumonia, but something else is going on. A woman in severe back pain after slipping on concrete at work can’t feel anything when Dr Ilya Kardailsky prods her side with a needle. Dr Michelle Thornhill examines a teenager in agony after he fell five metres onto his back while riding a dirt bike.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s ED, doctors Tinnie Chang and Caitlin Young fear a cyclist has potentially life-changing injuries. The man is in intense pain with protruding broken bones after he collided with a ute. Doctors Terry Kane and Bjorn Makein see warning signs when they examine a 30-year-old man with severe chest pain who has a history of collapsed lungs. Dr Emma West suspects a happy older man is hiding his injuries after a motorbike crash, but scans reveal the truth.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s ED, doctors Jonathan Papson and Emma West struggle to remove a glove that’s embedded in a construction worker’s mangled hand. Dr Tristan Harding and nurse Tanya Wallace carefully check the spine of a man in agony after he fell off a roof. Dr Assiya Halid examines the shocking injuries of a driver who smashed his lovingly restored car into a wall. Nurse Practitioner Paul Casey and Dr Jana Alexander delicately remove something painful from a woman’s ear.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, Dr Emma West is on high alert treating a woman’s life-threatening injuries from a car accident. Dr Sarah Whitelaw isn’t sure what she’ll find under the bandages on a man whose foot was slashed by a lawn mower blade. Dr Jonathan Papson prepares for the worst after a paraglider, who is also a nurse, fell 30 metres and landed on his head. Dr Tsung Chung guides Junior Dr Norah O’Sullivan as she checks on a man who’s vomiting blood.

programme.desc: Edmund finds Kelsey just as her contractions begin. The Cutting Edge erupts over Michael’s firing, with Trevor and Laurel defending him on air. Then a gunshot rings out and everyone hits the ground.

programme.title: All My Children
programme.desc: Laurel is shot at The Cutting Edge and Trevor is losing it. Noah is sentenced to 25 years. Edmund delivers Kelsey’s baby in a storm. Then Jack announces the studio cameras caught the shooter on tape.

programme.title: All My Children
programme.desc: Laurel dies, and the studio tape identifies Janet as the shooter. Jack arrests her for Laurel’s murder. Kelsey and the baby are healthy. Then the bus taking Noah to prison is run off the road.

programme.title: All My Children
programme.desc: Noah escapes the crash with Taylor’s help and calls Julia. Trevor can’t bring himself to tell Amanda her mother is gone. Then Noah tells Taylor he loves Julia, and Taylor pulls her gun on them.

programme.title: All My Children
programme.desc: Pierce is losing faith in Janet as the tape makes her guilt hard to deny. The station plans to air the footage. Noah and Julia race to the docks for a cargo ship as Taylor vows to bring Julia down.

programme.title: All My Children
programme.desc: Trevor tells Amanda her mother is gone, then learns Janet was arrested for Laurel’s murder. Erica chafes at Betty Ford. Kelsey signs over the baby and Edmund and Maria prepare to bring him home.

programme.title: All My Children
programme.desc: Erica walks out of Betty Ford. Trevor visits Janet in jail and vows to kill her. Internal affairs is questioning Taylor about the bus crash. Then Janet hears her dark inner voice in her cell.

programme.title: All My Children
programme.desc: Tad’s renewed commitment collapses when the shooting replay airs and Dixie walks out. Erica bolts from Betty Ford. Laura lands in Janet’s jail cell as Janet’s dark inner voice pushes for revenge.

programme.desc: Jason is recognized at an AA meeting for his role in the shooting. Kelsey agrees to breastfeed Edmund and Maria’s baby. Brooke takes in Laura, and Janet’s inner voice turns on Brooke for it.

programme.desc: Liza celebrates big ratings while Tad watches his marriage pay the price. Noah and Julia find a dead body on the cargo ship. Jason flashes back to the shooting and sees who had the gun.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: In Istanbul, the best Light Heavyweight will be determined as Tyrone Spong vs. Saulo Cavalari and Gokhan Saki vs. Nathan Corbett start off the 4-Man Championship Tournament. Also, Robin van Roosmalen faces Marat Grigorian in the main event. Van Roosmalen tries to get back to his winning ways after suffering a tough K.O. in his last fight.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: This event featured Glory Light Heavyweight World Championship Tournament for the inaugural Glory Light Heavyweight Championship. Two bouts was held as semi-finals. The winners of the semi-finals proceeded to the final bout for the tournament championship. This event also featured other non-tournament one-off bouts, the two headlines.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: This event featured world title fight for the inaugural Glory Welterweight Championship of Karapet Karapetyan vs. Marc de Bonte as headliner, and 4 Man Heavyweight Contender Tournament.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 16 slams into Denver with the Welterweight World Title fight, the Heavyweight Contender Tournament, and the debut of USA Martial Arts sensation Pat Barry. Belgian striker Marc de Bonte will battle Armenia's technical machine Karapet Karapetyan for the vacant GLORY Welterweight World Title, guaranteeing a fast, explosive war. At the heaviest end of the GLORY ranks, the big-boys are set to battle it out for a higher ranked spot in the Heavyweight division, and a chance to fight for the Title later within the year. The lineup pits Errol "The Bonecrusher" Zimmerman versus "Bangin" Ben Edwards in a semi-final, and Sergei "The Paratrooper" Kharitonov vs. Anderson "Braddock" Silva in another semi-final. The tournament winner will have to win two fights in one night to claim the prize, and the right to fight for a bigger prize later in the year. Also at Heavyweight, in a tournament reserve match, MMA veteran Pat "HD" Barry returns to his original love of kickboxing, facing another GLORY debutant in the shape of Zack "The Black Warrior" Mwekassa.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: On the preliminary card, a 4-Man Featherweight Contender Tournament and other one-off bouts were featured.Mirko Cro Cop was first scheduled to face Pat Barry, and later Sergei Kharitonov on this card. However, on May 21, it was announced that Kharitonov had to withdraw from the fight due to injury. He was replaced by Jarrell Miller.Miguel Torres was scheduled to make his GLORY debut as a participant of the Featherweight tournament. However, on May 28, it was revealed he pulled out of the tournament for undisclosed reasons. He was replaced by Marcus Vinicius.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: "Last Man Standing" features a lineup of the world's top Middleweight talent: EIGHT men will fight to the finish in a ONE night tournament, with the tournament winner being crowned the GLORY Middleweight Champion of the World. Last Man Standing will also feature TWO World Title fights, including Daniel Ghita versus Rico Verhoeven for the vacant Heavyweight Title, and Marc de Bonte versus Joseph Valtellini as de Bonte defends his newly won Welterweight Title.

A clash takes place between the two young men; but the behaviour of Nicola, who defends Gaetano from the commissioner Ajossa who has caught them duelling, gives rise to a deep friendship between the two. programme.title: La semaine verte
programme.desc: "La semaine verte" présente chaque semaine des reportages, des portraits ou des dossiers d'actualité dans les domaines de l'agriculture, de l'alimentation, de la foresterie, des pêches, de la gestion de la faune et de l'environnement. Elle suit de près l'actualité du monde rural, mais s'adresse tout autant à une clientèle urbaine de plus en plus intéressée par la qualité de ce que l'on mange, par la sauvegarde de l'environnement et par la gestion de nos ressources renouvelables.

programme.title: La facture
programme.desc: Cette émission hebdomadaire vise à démystifier l'univers de la consommation au sens large et des services publics. Elle informe les Canadiens et les Canadiennes au sujet de leurs droits et les guide dans leurs rapports avec les commerces, les entreprises et les organismes publics. Chaque semaine, La facture enquête sur les problèmes vécus par des citoyens et des citoyennes. La quasi-totalité des reportages tirent d'ailleurs leur source des témoignages de gens qui nous contactent de toutes les régions du pays. L'émission répond également aux questions du public.

programme.title: L'épicerie
programme.desc: Les questions concernant l'alimentation sont innombrables et entraînent l'équipe de "L'épicerie" dans toutes les directions: valeur nutritive, économie et consommation, marketing, culture et société. Tous les sujets relatifs à l'alimentation sont susceptibles de figurer au menu de l'émission. On y retrouve des trucs simples, mais efficaces pour préparer ou conserver les aliments, des invitations à découvrir des produits du terroir ou des façons d'apprêter les plats inspirés des traditions culinaires de diverses communautés culturelles. Les animateurs mettent aussi à l'épreuve les instruments dont on se sert en cuisine et suggèrent les meilleurs achats de la semaine.

programme.title: Découverte
programme.desc: "Découverte" est le magazine de vulgarisation scientifique de la télévision française de Radio-Canada. Diffusé à une heure de grande écoute, le dimanche en début de soirée, ce magazine hebdomadaire d'une heure attire chaque semaine quelque 650 000 téléspectateurs, soit près de 20 pour cent de l'auditoire disponible à cette heure. L'émission couvre les faits médicaux, scientifiques et techniques de pointe, mais ses reportages ciblent en particulier les équipes de recherche canadiennes et québécoises et les problématiques qui ont un impact immédiat pour notre public.
